args.command:
cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
from rdkit.Chem.rdchem import BondType

rw=Chem.RWMol()

def atom(sym, charge=0):
    a=Chem.Atom(sym); a.SetFormalCharge(charge); idx=rw.AddAtom(a); return idx

def bond(i,j,t=BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(i,j,t)

au=atom('Au')
# Create two equivalent Ge coordination fragments
for side in range(2):
    ge=atom('Ge')
    bond(au,ge)
    # Indole: N, C2, C3, fused C3a, C4,C5,C6,C7,fused C7a
    N=atom('N'); A1=atom('C'); A2=atom('C'); A3=atom('C'); A4=atom('C'); A5=atom('C'); A6=atom('C'); A7=atom('C'); A8=atom('C')
    # ring bonds, Kekule indole
    bond(N,A1); bond(A1,A2,BondType.DOUBLE); bond(A2,A3); bond(A3,A8,BondType.DOUBLE); bond(A8,N)
    bond(A3,A4); bond(A4,A5,BondType.DOUBLE); bond(A5,A6); bond(A6,A7,BondType.DOUBLE); bond(A7,A8)
    # 3-methyl
    m1=atom('C'); bond(A2,m1)
    # five-membered N-N heterocycle with two donor N
    nmid=atom('N'); nlow=atom('N'); cA=atom('C'); cB=atom('C'); cC=atom('C')
    bond(nmid,nlow); bond(nlow,cA,BondType.DOUBLE); bond(cA,cB); bond(cB,cC); bond(cC,nmid,BondType.DOUBLE)
    # connect indole C2 to heterocycle Cc
    bond(A1,cC)
    # phenyl substituent on cA
    p=[atom('C') for _ in range(6)]
    bond(cA,p[0]);
    for i in range(6): bond(p[i],p[(i+1)%6], BondType.DOUBLE if i%2==1 else BondType.SINGLE)
    # methyl substituent on heterocycle cB
    m2=atom('C'); bond(cB,m2)
    # Ge donor bonds from all three N atoms (dative)
    for ni in (N,nmid,nlow): rw.AddBond(ni,ge,BondType.DATIVE)

# n-propyl anion counterion, terminal anion on left end
c0=atom('C',-1); c1=atom('C'); c2=atom('C')
bond(c0,c1); bond(c1,c2)

mol=rw.GetMol()
try:
    Chem.SanitizeMol(mol)
    print('sanitize ok',mol.GetNumAtoms())
except Exception as e:
    print('sanitize failed',e)
    raise
mol=Chem.AddHs(mol)
print('atoms with H',mol.GetNumAtoms())
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=150; params.maxIterations=1000
params.useMacrocycleTorsions=True
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol,params)
print('embed',res)
if res<0:
    raise SystemExit('embed fail')
# optimize using UFF if possible
try:
    print('UFF params?',AllChem.UFFHasAllMoleculeParams(mol))
    ff=AllChem.UFFGetMoleculeForceField(mol,ignoreInterfragInteractions=False)
    print(ff.Minimize(maxIts=500))
except Exception as e: print('UFF opt err',e)
conf=mol.GetConformer()
# Orient system: Au centered, Ge-metal axis X, propyl counterion away above
# Translate Au to origin
pAu=conf.GetAtomPosition(au)
for i in range(mol.GetNumAtoms()):
    p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i); conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(p.x-pAu.x,p.y-pAu.y,p.z-pAu.z))
# Place propyl components away from complex in +z direction
# Set counteranion approx 8 A away from center to avoid unnatural overlaps; preserve its shape
coords=[conf.GetAtomPosition(i) for i in range(mol.GetNumAtoms())]
# Counterion indexes c0,c1,c2 plus newly added H after original heavy atoms. Shift all atoms in disconnected component
# Find component atoms from c0 via graph
seen={c0}; stack=[c0]
while stack:
    i=stack.pop()
    for nb in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors():
        j=nb.GetIdx()
        if j not in seen: seen.add(j); stack.append(j)
for i in list(seen):
    for nb in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors():
        if nb.GetAtomicNum()==1: seen.add(nb.GetIdx())
for i in seen:
    p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i); conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(p.x+0.5,p.y+0.5,p.z+8.0))

with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{mol.GetNumAtoms()}\n')
    f.write('Approximate 3D structure from mol_0150.png\n')
    for i,a in enumerate(mol.GetAtoms()):
        p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
        f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .6f} {p.y: .6f} {p.z: .6f}\n')

args.command:
python - <<'PY'
p='build.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("au=atom('Au')
# Create two equivalent Ge coordination fragments
for side in range(2):", "au=atom('Au')
ligand_groups=[]
# Create two equivalent Ge coordination fragments
for side in range(2):
    first_idx=rw.GetNumAtoms()")
s=s.replace("    for ni in (N,nmid,nlow): rw.AddBond(ni,ge,BondType.DATIVE)
", "    donors=(N,nmid,nlow)
    for ni in donors: rw.AddBond(ni,ge,BondType.DATIVE)
    ligand_groups.append((ge, list(range(first_idx, rw.GetNumAtoms())), donors))
")
start=s.index("# Orient system: Au centered")
end=s.index("with open('answer.xyz'", start)
new='''# Reconstruct a sensible linear Au-Ge-Ge core while retaining each embedded ligand geometry.
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
import numpy as np
conf=mol.GetConformer()
# Put Au at the origin. Embedder does not reliably enforce unsupported metal distances.
pAu=conf.GetAtomPosition(au)
coords=np.array([[conf.GetAtomPosition(i).x-pAu.x, conf.GetAtomPosition(i).y-pAu.y, conf.GetAtomPosition(i).z-pAu.z] for i in range(mol.GetNumAtoms())])
coords[au]=[0.0,0.0,0.0]
for side,(ge, group, donors) in enumerate(ligand_groups):
    nd=np.array([coords[i] for i in donors])
    # Best-fit position for Ge at approximately 2.0 A from its three coordinating N donors.
    center0=nd.mean(axis=0)
    fit=least_squares(lambda c: np.linalg.norm(nd-c,axis=1)-2.00, center0)
    center=fit.x
    # ligand heavy-atom centroid to choose an outward-facing arrangement
    heavy=[i for i in group if mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()>1 and i!=ge]
    com=coords[heavy].mean(axis=0)
    v=com-center
    target=np.array([-1.0,0,0]) if side==0 else np.array([1.0,0,0])
    if np.linalg.norm(v)<1e-5: v=np.array([0,1,0])
    v=v/np.linalg.norm(v)
    # Rodrigues rotation mapping v onto the desired outward direction
    cross=np.cross(v,target); sn=np.linalg.norm(cross); cs=np.dot(v,target)
    if sn<1e-9:
        R=np.eye(3) if cs>0 else np.diag([-1.,-1.,1.])
    else:
        K=np.array([[0,-cross[2],cross[1]],[cross[2],0,-cross[0]],[-cross[1],cross[0],0]])
        R=np.eye(3)+K+K@K*((1-cs)/(sn*sn))
    newcenter=np.array([-2.40,0,0]) if side==0 else np.array([2.40,0,0])
    for i in group:
        coords[i]=(coords[i]-center)@R.T+newcenter
    coords[ge]=newcenter
# translate disconnected propyl anion to a nearby solvent-separated position
# Find counterion connected component and its attached explicit H atoms.
seen={c0}; stack=[c0]
while stack:
    i=stack.pop()
    for nb in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors():
        j=nb.GetIdx()
        if j not in seen: seen.add(j); stack.append(j)
for i in list(seen):
    for nb in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors():
        if nb.GetAtomicNum()==1: seen.add(nb.GetIdx())
# Keep propyl geometry, but move it away from the metal complex.
com=np.mean(coords[list(seen)],axis=0)
shift=np.array([0.,7.0,5.0])-com
for i in seen: coords[i]+=shift
for i,p in enumerate(coords): conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(float(p[0]),float(p[1]),float(p[2])))

'''
s=s[:start]+new+s[end:]
# change output loops since p uses conformer okay
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
python build.py
